svg.title: Icarus Verilog Waveform: CORDIC Vectoring Mode (Opcode 01, x = -10, y = +10, Quadrant II)
svg.text: Icarus Verilog Waveform: CORDIC Vectoring Mode (Opcode 01, x = -10, y = +10, Quadrant II)
Two-pulse operand load (MODE=0 latches xin=-10, MODE=1 loads y=+10 with +90 deg pre-rotation)
C2 (25ns): START=1 with MODE=0 latches xin = -10 (0x36); BUSY stays 0.
C4 (45ns): START=1 with MODE=1 folds (-10, +10) by -90 deg into Quadrant I: vx0=+80, vy0=+80, vz0=+512 (+90 deg).
C5..C12 (55..125ns): Vectoring drives cy toward 0 (80 -> 0 -> -80 -> -40 -> -18 -> -7 -> -2 -> 0 -> -1); cx reaches 189, cz reaches 766.
C12 (125ns): RSEL=0 outputs scaled length 189>>3 = 23 (vs 1.6467*14.14 = 23.29). C13 (135ns): RSEL=1 outputs angle 766>>3 = 95 (133.6 deg vs 135 deg).
